item.title: Know Thy Selfie: Identifying Myself in Pictures Using DeepFace
item.description: Could you pick me out as a face in a crowd? Could you do it as well as AI? This post explores that a bit and some shortcomings of face verification in DeepFace.

item.title: Using Principal Component Analysis to Save Space on my Phone
item.description: In this post I use a combination of OpenAI's CLIP model, PyTesseract, and Principal Component Analysis to identify, crop, and downsample pictures of text labels to the most pertinent content.
